newsitem.title: ITALY: Santander to have 6 pct San Paolo.
newsitem.headline: Santander to have 6 pct San Paolo.

text.p: Spanish Banco Santander's stake in Italy's Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino will rise to six percent but it will be a core shareholder in the soon-to-be-privatised Turin bank with just five percent.
A San Paolo official was commenting on a Spanish press article which said Santander was raising its three percent stake in San Paolo to six percent.

He said in that in reality the operation, regarding 24,479,786 shares at 10,300 lire each under a June 1995 accord, would come into effect only after Italian stockmarket regulator Consob gave its formal go-ahead for San Paolo's flotation.
A group of strategic shareholders in San Paolo has already been formed with a combined holding of some 20 percent. A further 25 percent will be publicly floated in a second phase.
